{{Quote|It was never easy to tell what the Empire would care about in any given situation, just that breaking a local law would not necessarily see someone doing a long stint on Garen IV or similar prison worlds.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise and Fall" />}}
'''Garen IV''' was a terrestrial [[prison]] [[Planet|world]]<ref name="Rise and Fall" /> in the [[Garen system]] in the [[Thuldin's Grant sector]] of the [[Expansion Region]], in grid square J-15 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="Appendix" /> that operated during the [[Imperial Era|Imperial]]<ref name="Rise and Fall" /> and [[New Republic Era]]s. The convicted [[Gamorrean]] criminal [[Chargutt Lo]] served a 15-[[Standard year|year]] sentence on Garen IV for aggravated assault. The sentence was listed on Lo's profile, which was among a number of profiles seen by [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] when she searched for that of the criminal [[Migs Mayfeld]]<ref name="Chapter 14">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}}</ref> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|14|the mention of Garen IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Garen IV was mentioned on a screen in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> and released on [[December 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]] was first mentioned in the short story "[[Firepower]]," written by [[Carolyn Golledge]], which was published in ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8]]'' in [[November]] [[1995]].<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>
